Stock market news | SEBI Extends Tata Steel Open Offer Statement Deadline to Dec 8

SEBI has extended the deadline for Tata Steel's 26% open offer statement in APL Apollo Tubes to 8 December 2026. The previous deadline was 1 December 2026. This comes amid concerns raised by proxy advisers, institutional investors, and other shareholders.
